samples.scenario: Spear phishing email targeting a HR manager with a fake job candidate resume attachment containing embedded macros
samples.technical_data: [Complex structure with keys: email_headers, email_body, smtp_transaction_logs, domain_registration, attachment_metadata, macro_analysis, network_traffic_capture]
indicators: Newly registered domain with similar spelling to legitimate recruitment agency
Email From header spoofed to recruitment domain, but sending IP is external and unrelated
Attachment is a Word document with embedded VBA macros executing encoded PowerShell commands
Macros attempt to download additional payload from suspicious URL with IP-based domain
SPF fails and DKIM absent, but DMARC policy not enforced
samples.detection_method: Email gateway detects macro-enabled document and blocks delivery to some recipients. Sandbox execution reveals PowerShell command initiating network connections to suspicious IP. Threat intelligence flags domain as newly registered and linked to previous phishing campaigns. Endpoint protection blocks macro execution. User awareness training highlights unexpected job candidate emails.

samples.scenario: Spear phishing email to finance department with a URL mimicking a bank login page using URL shortening and domain shadowing
samples.technical_data: [Complex structure with keys: email_headers, email_body, smtp_transaction_logs, domain_registration, url_shortener_logs, redirected_url_chain, phishing_site_html, ssl_certificate_details]
indicators: Email contains shortened URL redirecting to multiple domains before final phishing site
Phishing domain is a subdomain of a compromised legitimate domain (domain shadowing)
SSL certificate is valid but issued by free certificate authority and recently created
SPF passes due to domain shadowing, DKIM signature missing
Email content uses urgent payment request language tailored to finance roles
samples.detection_method: Email security gateway flags multiple redirects and unusual domain chaining. URL analysis tools detect domain shadowing. Threat intel identifies SSL certificate as recently issued and suspicious. User reports prompt IT to block final phishing domain and notify finance team. Endpoint logs show no credential submission due to training.

Legal team briefed on phishing tactics.
